summary: Full end-to-end testing of HANEULZ fan site. All 17 backend pytest cases pass (public AUs, submissions, likes, comments, variety, auth, admin moderation). All frontend flows verified via Playwright: home hero, AU library grid + filters, AU detail with like increment, comment submission toast, submit-an-AU flow, variety corner, admin login redirect, admin dashboard tabs and approve action.

issues: Tab counts labeled 'AUS (1)' and 'NOTES (1)' appear to show pending-only counts, which may confuse users. Consider clarifying label (e.g., 'Pending AUs (1)') — minor UX polish only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~390 lines — acceptable but consider splitting into routers (auth, aus, comments, variety, admin) if it grows.
PATCH /api/admin/aus and /api/admin/comments accept a raw dict body — using a Pydantic model (e.g., StatusUpdate) would give proper validation & 422 responses instead of a manual 400 check.
seed() password-reset branch re-hashes on every startup when running with default password (verify_password is fine but the update is only conditional on mismatch — this is correct). No issue.
No rate limiting / captcha on public POST /api/aus and comments — could be spammed; acceptable for MVP.
GET /api/aus/{id}/comments does not check that the AU exists (returns [] silently for unknown ids). Minor.
seed_data_creation: Tests created temporary TEST_ prefixed AUs and comments; moderation flow test cleans up after itself. A couple of TEST_ pending AUs remain in DB from UI testing (harmless, hidden from public).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Frontend uses Lenis smooth scroll — use wait_for_load_state('domcontentloaded') + small wait_for_timeout rather than 'networkidle'. All data-testids listed in review request are present and functional. Admin tab counts show pending-only counts.
